new_datasets.name: WMT26 General MT Test Data
new_datasets.size: Test suites for WMT26 shared tasks (exact size TBD at conference)
new_datasets.description: WMT26 (Conference on Machine Translation 2026) released test data on June 19, 2026 for the General MT task. New shared tasks include Indic MT, Arabic-Asian MT, Chinese-Southeast Asian MT, Creole MT, Video Subtitle Translation, Multilingual Instruction (MIST), and Open Language Data. Submissions due July 2, results at WMT26 conference.
new_datasets.notes: Active evaluation campaign, not a static dataset. Results pending.

new_datasets.name: Translation Tangles
new_datasets.size: Multi-domain evaluation dataset (exact size in paper)
new_datasets.description: A unified framework and dataset for evaluating translation quality and fairness of open-source LLMs. Benchmarks 24 bidirectional language pairs across multiple domains using different metrics. Published in ACL 2026 Findings.
new_datasets.notes: ACL 2026 paper, focuses on fairness evaluation of LLM translation.

new_datasets.name: LangMark
new_datasets.description: Human-annotated multilingual dataset for Automatic Post-Editing (APE). Contains 206K triplets of English source, machine translation, and human post-edit across 7 language pairs. Published at ACL 2025, dataset released for research.
new_datasets.notes: First large-scale human-annotated APE dataset. Useful for post-editing model training.

supplementary_not_in_baseline.name: CUTE
supplementary_not_in_baseline.description: Chinese-Uyghur-Tibetan-English multilingual dataset for cross-lingual knowledge transfer. Largest open-source corpus for Uyghur and Tibetan. COLING 2025.
supplementary_not_in_baseline.notes: Not in 20-day window but significant for low-resource Chinese minority languages.

supplementary_not_in_baseline.name: BeitTigreAI/tigre-data-parallel-multilingual
supplementary_not_in_baseline.description: Parallel multilingual dataset including Tigrinya (ትግርኛ), a low-resource Ethiopian/Eritrean language. 330K rows. Updated Nov 2025.

search_methodology.notes: Mid-summer lull (post-ICML/ACL 2026 paper acceptance period). WMT26 evaluation phase active.
